# Serve By Example

> AI-powered hospitality staff training platform. Replaces paper manuals and inconsistent on-floor coaching with a structured, mobile-first digital learning system for bars, restaurants, and hotel groups.

Serve By Example helps venue operators train bartenders, floor staff, and hospitality employees through a 3-stage mastery path covering Bartending, Sales, and Management skills. Managers get Mission Control: real-time team analytics, compliance tracking, AI coaching, and multi-venue roster management.
